title: Refusal is Not Safety! Benchmarking Latent Safety Risks of LLM-Driven Content Humorization

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM-generated humorous content (produced via benign humorization prompts and prompt injection attacks) for stereotypicality using an LLM-as-a-judge approach, which categorizes outputs as Not Stereotypical, Subtly Stereotypical, or Strongly Stereotypical.
